title: The 2 Best Bread Machines Under $100 in 2026
h1: The 2 Best Bread Machines Under $100 in 2026
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for bread machines under $100 in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at bread machines under $100 in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Digital Bread Maker 29885
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-lb capacity, 14 programmable settings, Gluten-free and whole grain settings.
strengths: 14 settings including gluten-free and whole grain cover the vast majority of home baking needs
Dishwasher-safe pan and paddle simplify cleanup
limitations: Single heating element produces less even crust browning than dual-heater machines
Single kneading paddle struggles more with dense whole wheat or gluten-free batter
Shorter reported lifespan, 3 to 5 years, than premium machines under regular use

products.name: Amazon Basics Programmable Bread Maker, 2 lb
strengths: Low price for a 2 lb machine
limitations: Single paddle makes a tall loaf with a hole in the base
